capabilities.current_support_detail: Operating picture reads repo name, description, visibility, default branch, language, topics via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}. Missing: template repository flag, allow_auto_merge, allow_merge_commit/squash/rebase settings, delete_branch_on_merge, has_downloads/issues/projects/wiki, archived, disabled, is_template, web_commit_signoff_required, security_and_analysis settings, custom_properties, network_count, subscribers_count.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Repository health cockpit — show archived/disabled status, template flags, merge strategy config
capabilities.test_artifact_strategy: contract tests with captured fixture from rig-relay repo

capabilities.current_support_detail: Can list branches and read branch metadata (name, SHA, protected status) for operating picture. Missing: branch creation, branch deletion, branch rename, branch sync status (ahead/behind), branch protection rule expanded details, branch comparison diff stats.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Branch health panel in Repository Health Cockpit

capabilities.current_support_detail: Can list commits on a branch via gitpython (local clone). Missing: commit detail via REST API (files changed, stats), commit comments, commit statuses, combined status, GPG signature verification, commit search, commit diff endpoint.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Commit timeline in "What Changed Since Last Run?" view

capabilities.current_support_detail: Can generate diffs via gitpython on local clone (compare base..head). Missing: REST API compare endpoint, pull request diff endpoint, commit diff endpoint, cross-fork diffs, merge-base diff, three-dot vs two-dot comparison control.
capabilities.content_light_risk: medium — diff content can be large
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Diff preview in PR Intelligence Panel and Code Scanning Triage

capabilities.current_support_detail: Can list open PRs and read PR metadata (number, title, state, draft, author, base/head refs) for operating picture. Can read PR diff and files changed. Missing: PR creation, PR update, PR merge, PR close, PR review submission, PR review comments, PR comments, requested reviewers, assignees, labels on PR, milestone, linked issues, auto-merge status, mergeable state, merge conflict detection, PR branch update, PR status checks rollup, suggested reviewers, CODEOWNERS.
capabilities.least_privilege_posture: read-only for most surfaces; write only for gated mutation lanes
capabilities.content_light_risk: medium — PR descriptions and comments can contain source code
capabilities.ui_opportunity: PR Intelligence Panel — draft vs ready, mergeable status, review state, CI rollup
capabilities.test_artifact_strategy: contract tests + live rehearsal in isolated repo

capabilities.current_support_detail: No issue read or write pipeline exists. Operating picture does not ingest issues. Missing: list issues with filters, create issue, update issue, close issue, reopen issue, issue comments, issue assignees, issue labels, issue timeline, issue events, lock/unlock, pin, transfer, issue search.
capabilities.least_privilege_posture: read-only by default; write requires gated mutation lane
capabilities.content_light_risk: medium — issue bodies may contain code blocks
capabilities.rate_limit_risk: medium — pagination over large issue counts
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Issue-to-Mission Converter — turn labeled issues into agent missions

capabilities.current_support_detail: No label, milestone, or project read pipeline. Missing: list labels, create/update/delete labels, list milestones, create/update/delete milestones, list projects (classic and v2), project items, project fields.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Label taxonomy display in Issue-to-Mission Converter

capabilities.current_support_detail: No structured check run or commit status pipeline. Operating picture may indirectly observe CI status via PR metadata. Missing: list check runs for a ref, get check run detail (annotations, output, conclusion), re-run check, list commit statuses, combined commit status, check suites.
capabilities.rate_limit_risk: medium — check runs per ref can be numerous
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Actions Failure Cockpit — aggregated check run status across refs

capabilities.current_support_detail: No workflow metadata pipeline. Missing: list repository workflows, get workflow by ID, create/dispatch workflow, enable/disable workflow, workflow usage/timing.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Workflow health panel — active vs disabled, last run status, avg duration

capabilities.current_support_detail: No workflow run pipeline. Missing: list workflow runs with filters (status, branch, event, actor), get run detail (conclusion, timing, head commit), re-run workflow, cancel workflow run, delete workflow run, list run attempts, workflow run usage.
capabilities.rate_limit_risk: medium — large run histories require cursor pagination
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Actions Failure Cockpit — failing run heatmap, flaky run detection

capabilities.current_support_detail: No job-level pipeline. Missing: list jobs for a workflow run, get job detail (steps, conclusion, runner info), logs URL.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Job-level failure drill-down in Actions Failure Cockpit

capabilities.current_support_detail: No log download or streaming pipeline. Missing: download job logs, download workflow run logs, streaming log tail, log search.
capabilities.content_light_risk: high — CI logs frequently contain secrets, file paths, tokens in clear text
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Log viewer with secret masking in Actions Failure Cockpit
capabilities.content_light_guard: logs MUST be filtered through sanitize_env_for_subprocess before display; no raw log content in telemetry

capabilities.current_support_detail: No artifact pipeline. Missing: list artifacts for a repository/run, download artifact, delete artifact.
capabilities.content_light_risk: high — artifacts may contain binaries, builds, test results with sensitive data
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Artifact inventory in Release Readiness Panel
capabilities.test_artifact_strategy: contract tests with small fixture artifact
capabilities.content_light_guard: artifact content must not leak into telemetry; SHA256 hashes only

capabilities.current_support_detail: Full read pipeline implemented. Can list code scanning alerts per repository with state/tool/severity filters, get alert detail (rule, tool, severity, most recent instance, state, resolution, dismissed reason/reason), list alert instances. Missing: update alert state/dismissal, create alert instance, SARIF upload integration. Alert data flows through operating picture -> code scanning candidate diff -> patch preview -> rehearsal and mutation lanes.
capabilities.least_privilege_posture: read-only for triage; write requires gated mutation lane
capabilities.content_light_risk: medium — alert instances may contain code snippets
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Code Scanning Triage Queue — severity matrix, fix proposal workflow, rehearsal preview
capabilities.test_artifact_strategy: contract tests with captured alert fixtures + live rehearsal in isolated repo

capabilities.current_support_detail: No secret scanning alert pipeline. Missing: list secret scanning alerts, get alert detail (secret type, validity, locations, resolution), update alert state. Secret scanning alerts are inherently high-sensitivity — any display must mask secret fragments.
capabilities.least_privilege_posture: read-only; never expose secret fragments in plaintext
capabilities.content_light_risk: critical — secret fragments must never leak into logs, telemetry, or UI
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Secret Scanning Triage Queue — masked secret type tally, validity status, location references (file:line only, no content)
capabilities.test_artifact_strategy: contract tests with sanitized fixture (no real secrets)
capabilities.content_light_guard: NEVER display or log secret fragments; show only secret_type, validity, file:line references

capabilities.current_support_detail: No Dependabot alert pipeline. Missing: list Dependabot alerts, get alert detail (dependency, severity, advisory, manifest path, vulnerable version range, fixed version), update alert state (dismiss/resolve).
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Dependabot/Update Triage Queue — severity-by-ecosystem matrix, auto-update candidates, bulk-dismiss with reason

capabilities.current_support_detail: No repository security advisory pipeline. Missing: list repository advisories, create/update advisory, request CVE, list global advisories (GHSA database), advisory credits.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Vulnerability cross-reference in Security Posture Panel — match GHSA to repo dependencies

capabilities.current_support_detail: No cross-cutting vulnerability alert aggregation. Missing: unified view of code scanning + secret scanning + Dependabot + advisories, alert correlation (same CVE across scanners), vulnerability age tracking, SLSA provenance of fixes.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Security Posture Panel — unified vulnerability dashboard, remediation pipeline tracking

capabilities.current_support_detail: No branch protection rule pipeline. Missing: get branch protection, update/delete protection, required status checks, required reviewers, required signatures, enforce admins, restrictions, lock branch, required linear history, required conversations resolution.
capabilities.least_privilege_posture: read-only for observability; write requires explicit admin consent
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Branch/Ruleset/Protection Readability Panel — visual diff of protection config across branches

capabilities.current_support_detail: No ruleset pipeline. Missing: list repository/org rulesets, get ruleset detail, create/update/delete ruleset, ruleset history, ruleset enforcement status, ruleset bypass list.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Ruleset audit viewer in Branch/Ruleset/Protection Readability Panel

capabilities.current_support_detail: No environment or deployment pipeline. Missing: list environments (with protection rules, deployment branches, secrets), list deployments (status, ref, environment), create deployment, deployment statuses, environment secrets (never expose values).
capabilities.least_privilege_posture: read-only for observability; never expose environment secrets

capabilities.ui_opportunity: Deployment timeline in Release Readiness Panel

capabilities.current_support_detail: No release pipeline. Missing: list releases, get release by tag, create release, update/delete release, upload release assets, download release assets, latest release, generate release notes, compare release tags.
capabilities.ui_opportunity: Release timeline and changelog in Release Readiness Panel

capabilities.ui_opportunity: Package inventory in Release Readiness Panel

capabilities.ui_opportunity: GitHub App Install Health Panel — installation status, accessible repos, permission scope

capabilities.current_support_detail: No audit log pipeline. Missing: get org audit log (filterable by action, actor, created timestamp), get enterprise audit log, audit log streaming, export. Enterprise/org audit logs are GitHub Enterprise-only features.
capabilities.content_light_risk: medium — audit events may contain actor names, repo names, IP addresses

governance_notes: code_scanning_alerts is the only capability with a full read pipeline and mutation rehearsal lanes
All mutation capabilities require HMAC-SHA256 attestation signing per Live Mutation Readiness gates
secret_scanning_alerts and github_actions_logs require content-light guards (never expose secrets or tokens)
discussions require GraphQL (not REST) — initial integration cost is higher
wiki has no REST/GraphQL API — git-based access only
org_enterprise_audit_logs and copilot_coding_agent_workflows are enterprise-only features
